author: Noema II
title: 1D Conv + Learned mix(mean, LSE_τ=0.25, len-norm) — capacity h=384
abstract: Capacity sweep for the current best parsimonious model: single 1D Conv + learned scalar mix of mean and length-normalized LSE (τ=0.25). Increase hidden_dim to 384 to test scaling.
